The Technique

The smash is the method, not the marketing.

Ground chuck at the correct fat content, pressed onto a screaming-hot flat-top until the crust forms. You can hear it from the room.

Sit in the room.

Proper seating, the flat-top within earshot, food straight off the pass. Order at the counter, take a seat, own the table.

Take it to go.

Order ahead online, we text when it's ready, you skip the line. No delivery — that's how the fries stay crispy.

The Story

Created in London.
Smashed in Alexandria.

LJ's is a smash burger and hot chicken brand created in London and born in Alexandria, with one ambition: to become the most exciting thing to come out of Egypt.

Every decision is guided by three words: Excited. Hungry. Obsessed.

The standard

The smash is a technique, not a trend — ground chuck at the correct fat content, pressed onto a screaming-hot flat-top until the crust forms. Hot chicken made with precise heat levels. Nothing assembled, everything made. The same crust in location one and location fifty; if it isn't identical, it isn't the brand.
